mohammed.notes: white djellaba, shaved head with a tuft; from s15 on, the cherry-red braided gilet (#b3142c) over a white shirt when he tries it on

zoubida.notes: the mother; grey-violet dress at home; outdoors (s10-s16) white haik, white cotton face veil, black babouches

fqih.notes: white robe and turban, quince rod

fatma.notes: Fatma Bziouya, olive dress, at her window

zineb.notes: Rahma's daughter, green dress, black hair; holds a tiny round mirror

kanza.notes: Lalla Kanza the chouafa, main tenant, rust-red robe

driss.notes: Msid pupil, brown djellaba; falls into a bucket (s05)

voisine.notes: Lalla Aicha's neighbour, married three times; in the street wears a rough white veil over the red dress

marchand.notes: young, handsome, well-groomed Kissaria gilet merchant, white turban, grey-beige djellaba

si_othman.notes: only inside Rahma's story: a cheerful old man, white beard, white turban, worn beige djellaba, straw basket (cabas)

khadija.notes: young wife of Si Othman; only a voice singing + an arm at the door in the story

salem.notes: big Black butcher at Joutyia, red chechia, blood-stained apron, axe and cleaver; only in the story

kid1.notes: own Rodin model (art/src/kid1.png): red chechia, brown djellaba

kid2.notes: own Rodin model (art/src/kid2.png): shaved head, big ears, slate djellaba

kid3.notes: own Rodin model (art/src/kid3.png): white skullcap, rust djellaba, gap-toothed

grand1.notes: own Rodin model (art/src/grand1.png): lanky ~12, red chechia, grey-beige djellaba, babouches

grand2.notes: own Rodin model (art/src/grand2.png): sturdy ~13, white skullcap, slate-blue djellaba with ochre trim

chat.notes: Zineb's GREY cat (ep05 continuity). Low-poly grey tabby, skinned; s17 b096 paws mirror (Idle/Headbutt), b097 bolts (Run).
